content.text: GitHub's AI secret scanning keeps creating false positives, for example [https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/security/secret-scanning/17](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/security/secret-scanning/17) - can you change its rules to not do that? It's annoying af.
I’ll inspect that alert and the repository’s scanning settings, then narrow the false-positive source if GitHub exposes a control for it.

Alert #17 is a Python package SHA-256 hash in an Entire session transcript, misclassified as a password. I’ll turn off GitHub’s AI secret detection for this repository and close #17 as a false positive. Standard secret scanning and push protection will stay enabled.

Done for `entireio/entire-graph`:

- Disabled [AI secret detection](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/how-tos/secure-your-secrets/detect-secret-leaks/enabling-secret-scanning-for-ai-detected-secrets), the feature producing these password alerts.
- Closed [#17](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/security/secret-scanning/17) as a false positive—it flagged a package SHA-256 hash.
- Verified standard secret scanning, push protection, and validity checks remain enabled.

This disables all AI-detected secret alerts for this repository. Other existing alerts remain unchanged.

import subprocess,json,re,concurrent.futures
repo='repos/entireio/entire-graph'
def inspect(n):
    a=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh','api',f'{repo}/secret-scanning/alerts/{n}'],text=True))
    value=a.get('secret','')
    is_hash=bool(re.fullmatch(r'(?:sha256:)?[0-9a-fA-F]{64}',value))
    locations=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh','api',f'{repo}/secret-scanning/alerts/{n}/locations'],text=True))
    print(json.dumps({'number':n,'package_hash_shape':is_hash,'locations':[{'type':x['type'],'path':x.get('details',{}).get('path'),'line':x.get('details',{}).get('start_line')} for x in locations]}),flush=True)
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) as ex:
    list(ex.map(inspect,range(3,17)))

import subprocess,json,base64,concurrent.futures
repo='repos/entireio/entire-graph'
def api(path):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh','api',path],text=True))
def inspect(n):
    a=api(f'{repo}/secret-scanning/alerts/{n}')
    d=api(f'{repo}/secret-scanning/alerts/{n}/locations')[0]['details']
    blob=api(f"{repo}/git/blobs/{d['blob_sha']}")
    line=base64.b64decode(blob['content']).decode().splitlines()[d['start_line']-1]
    start,end=d['start_column']-1,d['end_column']
    context=line[max(0,start-160):start]+'[REDACTED MATCH]'+line[end:end+160]
    print(json.dumps({'number':n,'context':context.replace(a['secret'],'[REDACTED MATCH]')}),flush=True)
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) as ex:
    list(ex.map(inspect,range(3,17)))
